title: Terrazzo Shower Curtain — Waterproof Polyester

seoDescription: Thickened waterproof polyester shower curtain in a soft terrazzo print. 5 neutral colourways and 12 sizes from 39″ to 95″ wide. Shop Drapewell.
descriptionHtml:
A calm, Nordic-inspired refresh for your bathroom. Thickened waterproof polyester in a soft terrazzo print — neutral enough to disappear into a minimalist room, textured enough to stop it feeling bare.

  • Waterproof and mildew-resistant — thickened polyester repels water and resists mildew wash after wash

title: Step-In Dog Harness & Leash Set — Reflective Mesh Vest
seoTitle: Step-In Dog Harness & Leash Set, Reflective | Drapewell
seoDescription: Step-in dog harness and leash set in a reflective mesh vest style. Sizes S to XL in 6 colours. Measure your dog's chest before ordering.
descriptionHtml:
An adjustable step-in harness vest with a matching leash. The harness is made of breathable mesh with reflective strips, and it comes in four sizes and six colours.

  • Step-in design – put your dog's front legs through, lift the harness, close the buckle and adjust the chest fit
  • Hook-and-loop and buckle – a double fastening, with two D-rings for attaching the leash
  • Breathable mesh – plaid mesh fabric, polyester, with reflective strips for low light
  • Leash included – nylon rope leash with a padded handle, a 360° swivel metal hook and reflective threading; the supplier notes it can also be used with other harnesses
  • Four sizes, six colours – S, M, L and XL in blue, green, red, orange, coffee or purple

Sizing

The supplier does not publish chest measurements for each size, and notes that sizes do not correspond to breed or weight. Measure the fullest part of your dog's chest with a soft tape before ordering. If your dog is between sizes, the supplier recommends ordering one size up.

Good to know: Fit the harness snugly and check the fit before every walk. The leash is described as suited to small dogs and puppies. Colours may vary slightly between screens. In the box: 1 harness vest, 1 leash.
